Hence the characteristic-by-characteristic nullity differences H1=0 outside 2,3,11; char2=3,char3=1,char11=2 hold over any field, not just sampled primes. The explicit D11 supplied in RESULT has quotient matrix [[8,0],[4,5]] mod11, determinant 7 and is checked as a derivation by source script; this is nonnilpotent on abelianization. The nilpotent filtration itself is independent of characteristic.
